run_errornodes_search: run the errornodes script to search stderr and stdout logs for failing distributed training nodes
run_errornodes_parse_logs: run the errornodes script to parse stderr and stdout logs and map error ranks to node names
run_errornodes_segmentation_fault: run the errornodes script to find segmentation fault errors across distributed training node logs
run_errornodes_torch_distributed: run the errornodes script to detect torch distributed elastic multiprocessing failures in node logs
run_errornodes_rsmi_mutex: run the errornodes script to find RSMI device mutex initialization failures in distributed training logs
